item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 12/Nov/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windy with swells over the coast of Guangdong today. A relatively dry monsoon is expected to affect southern China persistently, the weather will improve with slightly cooler mornings over the region in the latter part of this week. An intense northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China early next week. The weather will become cool appreciably over the region. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Fung-wong will move towards the vicinity of Taiwan and weaken gradually today.
